Roast or steam until the flesh is tender and the edges take on a little color. The sweetness concentrates as it cooks, so you need less added sugar or glaze.
Sage, apple, miso, lime, and toasted seeds all sit well next to kabocha. Pair it with beans, lentils, or a modest piece of fish so the squash is doing more than sitting on the side of the plate.
